name: Design Token System and Lit Component Library
description: Build the unified Tribunus component vocabulary on Lit (Web Components). Domain components: SessionCard, AgentRail, GateRequest, CommandReceipt, ProjectionStream, DharmaScore, QueueItem, CodexNode, DiagnosticPacket, ApprovalSheet, DevicePresence, RelayStatus, TrustBadge, ReceiptTimeline, MissionCard. Adapted via CSS Container Queries across form factors.
purpose: One component vocabulary serving all four surfaces. Built once, adapted via CSS — not four separate implementations.
acceptanceCriteria: All domain components implemented as Lit Web Components
CSS Container Queries adapt layouts without framework-specific logic
Components render compact on phone, split-pane on tablet, dense on desktop
Public mode attribute renders demo data; authenticated mode binds to projection stream
W3C DTCG design tokens as the shared design foundation
Component library documented with Storybook or equivalent
